additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
120 mana, 0.5 mana regeneration and 1% flat base magic resistance.
7 main attack damage to universal heroes.
Stacks multiplicatively with other magic resistance sources.
description: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.
tips: Generally used against spell based heroes or lineups when playing as a hero reliant on auto-attacks or one that uses skills that use attack modifiers.

The hidden power of Mage Slayer may be the fact it is the only magic damage reduction upgrade that gives raw damage per second increase to auto-attacks. Build into it from a Cloak if you feel you do not need the utility or support of a Glimmer Cape or the regeneration of a Hood of Defiance.

Remember that the debuff reduces all damage types, not just Magical damage. This makes it a great way to reduce the damage output of heroes that mostly use Pure damage or, more situationally, Physical damage via spells. Some common examples are Timbersaw, Outworld Destroyer, Silencer, and Blood finding for Pure damage spells, and Bristleback and Dazzle for Physical damage spells.

abilities.description: Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing 35 physical damage per second and causing them to do 40% less spell damage for 3 seconds.

name: Mage Slayer
